verses.kjv: The word of the LORD that came to Joel the son of Pethuel.
verses.modern: The word of the LORD that came to Joel son of Pethuel.

verses.kjv: Hear this, ye old men, and give ear, all ye inhabitants of the land. Hath this been in your days, or even in the days of your fathers?
verses.modern: Hear this, You elders; listen, all who live in the land. Has anything like this ever happened in your days or in the days of Your ancestors?

verses.kjv: Tell ye your children of it, and let your children tell their children, and their children another generation.
verses.modern: Tell it to Your children, and let Your children tell it to their children, and their children to the next generation.

verses.kjv: That which the palmerworm hath left hath the locust eaten; and that which the locust hath left hath the cankerworm eaten; and that which the cankerworm hath left hath the caterpiller eaten.
verses.modern: What the locust swarm has left, the great locusts have eaten; what the great locusts have left, the young locusts have eaten; what the young locusts have left, other locusts have eaten.

verses.kjv: Awake, ye drunkards, and weep; and howl, all ye drinkers of wine, because of the new wine; for it is cut off from your mouth.
verses.modern: Wake up, You drunkards, and weep! Wail, all You drinkers of wine; wail because of the new wine, for it has been snatched from Your lips.

verses.kjv: For a nation is come up upon my land, strong, and without number, whose teeth are the teeth of a lion, and he hath the cheek teeth of a great lion.
verses.modern: A nation has invaded My land, powerful and without number; it has the teeth of a lion, the fangs of a lioness.

verses.kjv: He hath laid my vine waste, and barked my fig tree: he hath made it clean bare, and cast it away; the branches thereof are made white.
verses.modern: It has laid waste My vines and ruined My fig trees. It has stripped off their bark and thrown it away, leaving their branches white.

verses.kjv: Lament like a virgin girded with sackcloth for the husband of her youth.
verses.modern: Mourn like a young woman dressed in sackcloth grieving for the husband of her youth.

verses.kjv: The meat offering and the drink offering is cut off from the house of the LORD; the priests, the LORD's ministers, mourn.
verses.modern: Grain offerings and drink offerings have been cut off from the house of the LORD. The priests mourn, those who minister before the LORD.

verses.kjv: The field is wasted, the land mourneth; for the corn is wasted: the new wine is dried up, the oil languisheth.
verses.modern: The fields are ruined, the ground is dried up; the grain is destroyed, the new wine is dried up, the olive oil fails.

verses.kjv: Be ye ashamed, O ye husbandmen; howl, O ye vinedressers, for the wheat and for the barley; because the harvest of the field is perished.
verses.modern: Despair, You farmers; wail, You vine growers; grieve for the wheat and the barley, because the harvest of the field is destroyed.

verses.kjv: The vine is dried up, and the fig tree languisheth; the pomegranate tree, the palm tree also, and the apple tree, even all the trees of the field, are withered: because joy is withered away from the sons of men.
verses.modern: The vine is dried up and the fig tree is withered; the pomegranate, the palm and the apple tree — all the trees of the field — are dried up. Surely the people's joy is withered away.

verses.kjv: Gird yourselves, and lament, ye priests: howl, ye ministers of the altar: come, lie all night in sackcloth, ye ministers of my God: for the meat offering and the drink offering is withholden from the house of your God.
verses.modern: Put on sackcloth, You priests, and mourn; wail, you who minister before the altar. Come, spend the night in sackcloth, You who minister before my God; for the grain offerings and drink offerings are withheld from the house of Your God.

verses.kjv: Sanctify ye a fast, call a solemn assembly, gather the elders and all the inhabitants of the land into the house of the LORD your God, and cry unto the LORD.
verses.modern: Declare a holy fast; call a sacred assembly. Summon the elders and all who live in the land to the house of the LORD Your God, and cry out to the LORD.

verses.kjv: Alas for the day! for the day of the LORD is at hand, and as a destruction from the Almighty shall it come.
verses.modern: What a dreadful day! For the day of the LORD is near; it will come like destruction from the Almighty.

verses.kjv: Is not the meat cut off before our eyes, yea, joy and gladness from the house of our God?
verses.modern: Has not the food been cut off before our very eyes — joy and gladness from the house of our God?

verses.kjv: The seed is rotten under their clods, the garners are laid desolate, the barns are broken down; for the corn is withered.
verses.modern: The seeds are shriveled beneath the clods. The storehouses are in ruins, the granaries have been broken down, for the grain has dried up.

verses.kjv: How do the beasts groan! the herds of cattle are perplexed, because they have no pasture; yea, the flocks of sheep are made desolate.
verses.modern: How the cattle moan! The herds mill about because they have no pasture; even the flocks of sheep are suffering.

verses.kjv: O LORD, to thee will I cry: for the fire hath devoured the pastures of the wilderness, and the flame hath burned all the trees of the field.
verses.modern: To You, LORD, I call, for fire has devoured the pastures in the wilderness and flames have burned up all the trees of the field.

verses.kjv: The beasts of the field cry also unto thee: for the rivers of waters are dried up, and the fire hath devoured the pastures of the wilderness.
verses.modern: Even the wild animals pant for You; the streams of water have dried up and fire has devoured the pastures in the wilderness.

chapters.summary: A devastating plague of locusts has stripped the land bare — what one swarm left, the next devoured. The fields are ruined, the vines dried up, the grain offering and drink offering cut off from the house of the LORD. Joel calls the priests and elders to proclaim a solemn fast and cry out to the LORD, for the day of the LORD is at hand.

verses.kjv: Blow ye the trumpet in Zion, and sound an alarm in my holy mountain: let all the inhabitants of the land tremble: for the day of the LORD cometh, for it is nigh at hand;
verses.modern: Sound the trumpet in Zion; sound the alarm on My holy mountain. Let all who live in the land tremble, for the day of the LORD is coming. It is close at hand —

verses.kjv: A day of darkness and of gloominess, a day of clouds and of thick darkness, as the morning spread upon the mountains: a great people and a strong; there hath not been ever the like, neither shall be any more after it, even to the years of many generations.
verses.modern: a day of darkness and gloom, a day of clouds and thick darkness. Like dawn spreading across the mountains, a large and mighty army comes — such as never was in ancient times nor ever will be in ages to come.

verses.kjv: A fire devoureth before them; and behind them a flame burneth: the land is as the garden of Eden before them, and behind them a desolate wilderness; yea, and nothing shall escape them.
verses.modern: Before them fire devours; behind them a flame blazes. Before them the land is like the garden of Eden; behind them, a desert waste — nothing escapes them.

verses.kjv: The appearance of them is as the appearance of horses; and as horsemen, so shall they run.
verses.modern: They have the appearance of horses; they gallop along like cavalry.

verses.kjv: Like the noise of chariots on the tops of mountains shall they leap, like the noise of a flame of fire that devoureth the stubble, as a strong people set in battle array.
verses.modern: With a noise like that of chariots they leap over the mountaintops, like a crackling fire consuming stubble, like a mighty army drawn up for battle.

verses.kjv: Before their face the people shall be much pained: all faces shall gather blackness.
verses.modern: At the sight of them, nations are in anguish; every face turns pale.

verses.kjv: They shall run like mighty men; they shall climb the wall like men of war; and they shall march every one on his ways, and they shall not break their ranks:
verses.modern: They charge like warriors; they scale walls like soldiers. They all march in line, not swerving from their course.

verses.kjv: Neither shall one thrust another; they shall walk every one in his path: and when they fall upon the sword, they shall not be wounded.
verses.modern: They do not jostle each other; each marches straight ahead. They plunge through defenses without breaking ranks.

verses.kjv: They shall run to and fro in the city; they shall run upon the wall, they shall climb up upon the houses; they shall enter in at the windows like a thief.
verses.modern: They rush upon the city; they run along the wall. They climb into the houses; like thieves they enter through the windows.

verses.kjv: The earth shall quake before them; the heavens shall tremble: the sun and the moon shall be dark, and the stars shall withdraw their shining:
verses.modern: Before them the earth shakes, the heavens tremble, the sun and moon are darkened, and the stars no longer shine.

verses.kjv: And the LORD shall utter his voice before his army: for his camp is very great: for he is strong that executeth his word: for the day of the LORD is great and very terrible; and who can abide it?
verses.modern: The LORD thunders at the head of His army; His forces are beyond number, and mighty is the army that obeys His command. The day of the LORD is great; it is dreadful. Who can endure it?

verses.kjv: Therefore also now, saith the LORD, turn ye even to me with all your heart, and with fasting, and with weeping, and with mourning:
verses.modern: "Even now," declares the LORD, "return to Me with all Your heart, with fasting and weeping and mourning."

verses.kjv: And rend your heart, and not your garments, and turn unto the LORD your God: for he is gracious and merciful, slow to anger, and of great kindness, and repenteth him of the evil.
verses.modern: Tear Your heart, and not Your garments. Return to the LORD Your God, for He is gracious and merciful, longsuffering, and of great kindness — and He relents from sending calamity.

verses.kjv: Who knoweth if he will return and repent, and leave a blessing behind him; even a meat offering and a drink offering unto the LORD your God?
verses.modern: Who knows? He may turn and relent and leave behind a blessing — grain offerings and drink offerings for the LORD Your God.

verses.kjv: Blow the trumpet in Zion, sanctify a fast, call a solemn assembly:
verses.modern: Sound the trumpet in Zion, declare a holy fast, call a sacred assembly.

verses.kjv: Gather the people, sanctify the congregation, assemble the elders, gather the children, and those that suck the breasts: let the bridegroom go forth of his chamber, and the bride out of her closet.
verses.modern: Gather the people, consecrate the assembly; bring together the elders, gather the children, those nursing at the breast. Let the bridegroom leave His room and the bride her chamber.

verses.kjv: Let the priests, the ministers of the LORD, weep between the porch and the altar, and let them say, Spare thy people, O LORD, and give not thine heritage to reproach, that the heathen should rule over them: wherefore should they say among the people, Where is their God?
verses.modern: Let the priests, who minister before the LORD, weep between the temple porch and the altar. Let them say, "Spare Your people, LORD. Do not make Your inheritance an object of scorn, a byword among the nations. Why should they say among the peoples, 'Where is their God?' "

verses.kjv: Then will the LORD be jealous for his land, and pity his people.
verses.modern: Then the LORD will be jealous for His land and take pity on His people.

verses.kjv: Yea, the LORD will answer and say unto his people, Behold, I will send you corn, and wine, and oil, and ye shall be satisfied therewith: and I will no more make you a reproach among the heathen:
verses.modern: The LORD will reply to them: "I am sending You grain, new wine, and olive oil, enough to satisfy You fully; never again will I make You an object of scorn to the nations.

verses.kjv: But I will remove far off from you the northern army, and will drive him into a land barren and desolate, with his face toward the east sea, and his hinder part toward the utmost sea, and his stink shall come up, and his ill savour shall come up, because he hath done great things.
verses.modern: I will drive the northern horde far from You, pushing it into a parched and barren land — its eastern ranks into the Dead Sea and its western ranks into the Mediterranean Sea. And its stench will go up; its smell will rise." Surely He has done great things!

verses.kjv: Fear not, O land; be glad and rejoice: for the LORD will do great things.
verses.modern: Do not be afraid, land of Judah; be glad and rejoice. Surely the LORD has done great things!

verses.kjv: Be not afraid, ye beasts of the field: for the pastures of the wilderness do spring, for the tree beareth her fruit, the fig tree and the vine do yield their strength.
verses.modern: Do not be afraid, You wild animals, for the pastures in the wilderness are becoming green. The trees are bearing their fruit; the fig tree and the vine yield their riches.

verses.kjv: Be glad then, ye children of Zion, and rejoice in the LORD your God: for he hath given you the former rain moderately, and he will cause to come down for you the rain, the former rain, and the latter rain in the first month.
verses.modern: Be glad, people of Zion, rejoice in the LORD Your God, for He has given You the autumn rains because He is faithful. He sends You abundant showers — both autumn and spring rains, as before.

verses.kjv: And the floors shall be full of wheat, and the fats shall overflow with wine and oil.
verses.modern: The threshing floors will be filled with grain; the vats will overflow with new wine and oil.

verses.kjv: And I will restore to you the years that the locust hath eaten, the cankerworm, and the caterpiller, and the palmerworm, my great army which I sent among you.
verses.modern: I will repay You for the years the locusts have eaten — the great locust and the young locust, the other locusts and the locust swarm — My great army that I sent among You.

verses.kjv: And ye shall eat in plenty, and be satisfied, and praise the name of the LORD your God, that hath dealt wondrously with you: and my people shall never be ashamed.
verses.modern: You will have plenty to eat, until You are full, and You will praise the name of the LORD Your God, Who has worked wonders for You; never again will My people be shamed.

verses.kjv: And ye shall know that I am in the midst of Israel, and that I am the LORD your God, and none else: and my people shall never be ashamed.
verses.modern: Then You will know that I am in Israel, that I am the LORD Your God, and that there is no other; never again will My people be shamed.

verses.kjv: And it shall come to pass afterward, that I will pour out my spirit upon all flesh; and your sons and your daughters shall prophesy, your old men shall dream dreams, your young men shall see visions:
verses.modern: And afterward, I will pour out My Spirit on all flesh. Your sons and daughters will prophesy, Your old men will dream dreams, Your young men will see visions.

verses.kjv: And also upon the servants and upon the handmaids in those days will I pour out my spirit.
verses.modern: Even on My servants, both men and women, I will pour out My Spirit in those days.

verses.kjv: And I will shew wonders in the heavens and in the earth, blood, and fire, and pillars of smoke.
verses.modern: I will show wonders in the heavens and on the earth — blood and fire and billows of smoke.

verses.kjv: The sun shall be turned into darkness, and the moon into blood, before the great and the terrible day of the LORD come.
verses.modern: The sun will be turned to darkness and the moon to blood before the coming of the great and dreadful day of the LORD.

verses.kjv: And it shall come to pass, that whosoever shall call on the name of the LORD shall be delivered: for in mount Zion and in Jerusalem shall be deliverance, as the LORD hath said, and in the remnant whom the LORD shall call.
verses.modern: And everyone who calls on the name of the LORD will be saved; for on Mount Zion and in Jerusalem there will be deliverance, as the LORD has said, even among the survivors whom the LORD calls.

chapters.summary: The trumpet sounds in Zion — a great army like locusts darkens the land, and the day of the LORD is near. Yet the LORD calls: "Turn to Me with all your heart, with fasting, weeping, and mourning — rend your heart and not your garments." If they repent, the LORD will pour out His Spirit on all flesh — sons and daughters will prophesy, old men will dream dreams, young men will see visions.

verses.kjv: For, behold, in those days, and in that time, when I shall bring again the captivity of Judah and Jerusalem,
verses.modern: In those days and at that time, when I bring again the captivity of Judah and Jerusalem,

verses.kjv: I will also gather all nations, and will bring them down into the valley of Jehoshaphat, and will plead with them there for my people and for my heritage Israel, whom they have scattered among the nations, and parted my land.
verses.modern: I will gather all nations and bring them down to the Valley of Jehoshaphat. There I will put them on trial for what they did to My inheritance, My people Israel — because they scattered My people among the nations and divided up My land.

verses.kjv: And they have cast lots for my people; and have given a boy for an harlot, and sold a girl for wine, that they might drink.
verses.modern: They cast lots for My people and traded boys for harlots; they sold girls for wine to drink.

verses.kjv: Yea, and what have ye to do with me, O Tyre, and Zidon, and all the coasts of Palestine? will ye render me a recompence? and if ye recompense me, swiftly and speedily will I return your recompence upon your own head;
verses.modern: Now what have you against Me, Tyre and Sidon and all you regions of Philistia? Are you repaying Me for something I have done? If you are paying Me back, I will swiftly and speedily return on your own heads what you have done.

verses.kjv: Because ye have taken my silver and my gold, and have carried into your temples my goodly pleasant things:
verses.modern: For you took My silver and My gold and carried off My finest treasures to your temples.

verses.kjv: The children also of Judah and the children of Jerusalem have ye sold unto the Grecians, that ye might remove them far from their border.
verses.modern: You sold the people of Judah and Jerusalem to the Greeks, that you might send them far from their homeland.

verses.kjv: Behold, I will raise them out of the place whither ye have sold them, and will return your recompence upon your own head:
verses.modern: See, I am going to rouse them out of the places to which you sold them, and I will return on your own heads what you have done.

verses.kjv: And I will sell your sons and your daughters into the hand of the children of Judah, and they shall sell them to the Sabeans, to a people far off: for the LORD hath spoken it.
verses.modern: I will sell Your sons and daughters to the people of Judah, and they will sell them to the Sabeans, a nation far away." The LORD has spoken.

verses.kjv: Proclaim ye this among the Gentiles; Prepare war, wake up the mighty men, let all the men of war draw near; let them come up:
verses.modern: Proclaim this among the nations: Prepare for war! Rouse the warriors! Let all the fighting men draw near and attack.

verses.kjv: Beat your plowshares into swords, and your pruninghooks into spears: let the weak say, I am strong.
verses.modern: Beat Your plowshares into swords and Your pruning hooks into spears. Let the weakling say, "I am strong!"

verses.kjv: Assemble yourselves, and come, all ye heathen, and gather yourselves together round about: thither cause thy mighty ones to come down, O LORD.
verses.modern: Come quickly, all You nations from every side, and assemble there. Bring down Your warriors, LORD!

verses.kjv: Let the heathen be wakened, and come up to the valley of Jehoshaphat: for there will I sit to judge all the heathen round about.
verses.modern: Let the nations be roused; let them advance into the Valley of Jehoshaphat, for there I will sit to judge all the nations on every side.

verses.kjv: Put ye in the sickle, for the harvest is ripe: come, get you down; for the press is full, the fats overflow; for their wickedness is great.
verses.modern: Swing the sickle, for the harvest is ripe. Come, trample the grapes, for the winepress is full and the vats overflow — so great is their wickedness!

verses.kjv: Multitudes, multitudes in the valley of decision: for the day of the LORD is near in the valley of decision.
verses.modern: Crowds upon crowds in the valley of decision! For the day of the LORD is near in the valley of decision.

verses.kjv: The sun and the moon shall be darkened, and the stars shall withdraw their shining.
verses.modern: The sun and moon will be darkened, and the stars no longer shine.

verses.kjv: The LORD also shall roar out of Zion, and utter his voice from Jerusalem; and the heavens and the earth shall shake: but the LORD will be the hope of his people, and the strength of the children of Israel.
verses.modern: The LORD will roar from Zion and thunder from Jerusalem; the earth and the heavens will tremble. But the LORD will be a refuge for His people, a stronghold for the people of Israel.

verses.kjv: So shall ye know that I am the LORD your God dwelling in Zion, my holy mountain: then shall Jerusalem be holy, and there shall no strangers pass through her any more.
verses.modern: Then You will know that I, the LORD Your God, dwell in Zion, My holy mountain. Jerusalem will be holy; never again will foreigners invade her.

verses.kjv: And it shall come to pass in that day, that the mountains shall drop down new wine, and the hills shall flow with milk, and all the rivers of Judah shall flow with waters, and a fountain shall come forth of the house of the LORD, and shall water the valley of Shittim.
verses.modern: In that day the mountains will drip new wine, and the hills will flow with milk; all the rivers of Judah will flow with waters. A fountain will come forth of the house of the LORD and will water the valley of Shittim.

verses.kjv: Egypt shall be a desolation, and Edom shall be a desolate wilderness, for the violence against the children of Judah, because they have shed innocent blood in their land.
verses.modern: But Egypt will be desolate, Edom a desert waste, because of violence done to the people of Judah, in whose land they shed innocent blood.

verses.kjv: But Judah shall dwell for ever, and Jerusalem from generation to generation.
verses.modern: Judah will be inhabited forever and Jerusalem through all generations.

verses.kjv: For I will cleanse their blood that I have not cleansed: for the LORD dwelleth in Zion.
verses.modern: For I will cleanse their blood that I have not cleansed, for the LORD dwells in Zion.

chapters.summary: The LORD will gather all nations into the valley of Jehoshaphat and judge them for scattering His people and dividing His land. The nations are called to beat their plowshares into swords — but the LORD will roar from Zion. In that day the mountains will drip with new wine, the hills will flow with milk, and the LORD will dwell in Zion forever.
